general_process: Admissions are conducted through official registration on the university admission portal. Candidates must complete online registration, submit relevant academic details and entrance exam qualifications, participate in counseling, and verify documents.
important_note: For official application deadlines, program cutoffs, seat intake, and program-wise eligibility criteria, callers must refer to the admission handouts published on the official website svkmnmimsgu.ac.in or contact the admissions office directly.
